desc: positive: Test QFQ's enqueue reentrant behaviour with netem
pre: ip link add dummy1 type dummy && ip link set dummy1 up
ip link set dev dummy1 up || true
ip addr add 10.10.10.10/24 dev dummy1 || true
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 handle 1:0 root qfq
tc class replace dev dummy1 parent 1:0 classid 1:1 qfq weight 100 maxpkt 1500
tc qdisc add dev dummy1 parent 1:1 handle 2:0 netem duplicate 100%
tc filter add dev dummy1 parent 1:0 protocol ip prio 1 u32 match ip protocol 1 0xff flowid 1:1

readback.cmd: tc -j -s qdisc ls dev dummy1 handle 1:0
readback.name: verify
